args.prompt:
Create one native high fidelity illustrated 2D fighting-game sprite atlas of OLD SNAKE from the ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots (2008 PLAYSTATION 3), matching the supplied actual original-game screenshots, not another Snake incarnation, not Touch or Portable Ops. Closest possible 1:1 original visible costume and equipment. Original aged, lean athletic elderly man, pronounced face wrinkles, thick GRAY MOUSTACHE, no beard, swept-back gray hair with longer gray nape, dark gray tied bandana and two short tails. Fitted dark charcoal / gray segmented OctoCamo suit, sculpted padded dark shoulders, charcoal chest panels with gray textured stretch mesh at upper arms and side torso, gray fitted trousers and dark knee reinforcement, dark combat boots reaching lower shin, entirely black tactical gloves. Original TAN / BROWN tactical webbing harness and modest pouches across chest, tan waist belt and tan crossed rear straps, no modern plate carrier or huge backpack. Solid Eye is a small BLACK ELECTRONIC MONOCULAR covering ANATOMICAL LEFT eye only, with slim black temple strap; the anatomical RIGHT eye is bare. This is not a pirate eyepatch and never migrates to right eye. Keep optic anatomically correct even when facing direction changes: near-side LEFT profile can show it clearly, RIGHT profile may hide some left optic beyond the nose. Dark bandana sits above optic, both distinct. No neon laser, optic powers, magic, aura, facecamo mask, modern redesign or prosthetic limbs. Keep the original proportions and elderly face, no generic young gray-haired soldier. Neutral matte muted original gray/tan palette (source camouflage pattern in other captures does not change the chosen baseline gray suit). Crisp detailed restrained hand-painted 2D sprite art with clean contour and consistent lighting. Native true transparent RGBA PNG, no background, ground shadows, checkerboard, text, labels, cell borders or disconnected props. Prefer wide 1536 x 1024 native image, exactly FOUR equally spaced COLUMNS by THREE ROWS = TWELVE separate complete full-body single-figure poses in row-major order. Each complete body with hair, hands, feet and all attached equipment fully inside its own cell, leave broad empty-alpha gutters and outer margins. One adult man per cell, no duplicate bodies or opponent. Homogeneous upright body scale; crouches and jumps bend limbs rather than enlarging heads or torsos.
ALL twelve figures face SCREEN LEFT, camera sees anatomical LEFT cheek, small BLACK Solid Eye covers near LEFT eye with its slim LEFT temple strap. Anatomical RIGHT eye remains bare on far side. Prominent thick light silver-gray moustache. Facing is authored independently and is not a mirrored RIGHT figure. SHEET C EXACTLY 12 DISTINCT COMPLETE FULL-BODY POSES, FOUR columns by THREE rows. Keep original body equipment and anatomy and single-figure action with no opponent. Selected gun is the original-game MK.2 PISTOL: long straight matte black integral cylindrical suppressor/barrel over a slim pistol grip, as supplied original PS3 2000s capture, not a rifle, revolver or modern Glock. One pistol only, held by anatomical RIGHT hand with LEFT glove support for two-handed aim. No laser sight beam, muzzle flash, bullet, robot or separate prop baked in. TOP ROW cell0 CQC grab windup, gun holstered, left open glove ready near chest, feet braced; cell1 CQC grab ACTIVE left open hand reaching straight toward facing direction, right forearm ready near own chest, low stance, no opponent; cell2 pistol SHOOT windup drawing original Mk.2 with right hand and bringing left glove underneath, muzzle starting to rise; cell3 pistol SHOOT ACTIVE, both black-gloved hands support pistol, right on grip/trigger and left under grip, arms extended naturally, original long suppressor muzzle held LEVEL and points toward facing direction, visible open end of muzzle, feet grounded. MIDDLE ROW cell4 pistol SHOOT recovery, muzzle angled slightly down but safely forward and hands draw near sternum; cell5 CHAFF GRENADE throw windup: original pistol HOLSTERED, right glove holds one SMALL DARK RECTANGULAR chaff grenade canister at shoulder with a short top fuse fitting, based on original CHAFF G. HUD silhouette, left glove forward for balance; cell6 CHAFF throw ACTIVE, anatomical right glove extends forward toward facing direction at shoulder height, wrist opens ready for release, tiny rectangular canister still visibly at fingertips, NO detached grenade, no explosion, smoke, frag sphere, magic or cloud; cell7 Solid Eye check, one LEFT gloved hand touches only the LEFT-eye electronic monocular lens/temple, right glove near belt, this is information equipment not an attack. BOTTOM ROW cell8 pistol manual reload startup, Mk.2 lowered close to torso in right glove, left glove near lower grip changing magazine, no loose hovering magazine; cell9 reload recovery, left support glove returns to right grip and pistol safely held low; cell10 physical CQC charge startup, pistol HOLSTERED, forward knee bends and left open glove lifts toward target, right elbow poised; cell11 physical CQC charge ACTIVE, firm grounded lunge, LEFT open glove reaches forward and RIGHT forearm bent for a real grappling leverage move, no opponent. Clear physical grounded martial stance, no dash speed trails or body aura. All figures same original scale; hand, equipment, muzzle and feet fully visible with clear empty-alpha separation.

output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-2101389f-1b92-4202-ac10-9b99288cdcc7.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
